title: Jai Bhim
synopsis: A determined lawyer takes up the case of a tribal man who has gone missing after being arrested, seeking justice for his family.
note: A powerful courtroom drama about dignity, truth and the fight for justice.

title: Soorarai Pottru
synopsis: An ambitious young man dreams of making air travel affordable for ordinary people, despite powerful obstacles.
note: An energetic story of ambition, persistence and taking flight.

title: Interstellar
synopsis: A group of explorers travels beyond this galaxy to discover whether mankind has a future among the stars.
note: A grand science-fiction journey with an intimate emotional centre.

title: Knives Out
synopsis: A detective investigates the death of a wealthy mystery novelist, uncovering secrets within the family.
note: A playful whodunit packed with sharp turns and memorable characters.

title: Manjummel Boys
synopsis: A holiday among friends takes a terrifying turn when one of them becomes trapped in the Guna Caves.
note: A tense survival story rooted in friendship and extraordinary courage.

title: Drishyam
synopsis: A family man uses his resourcefulness to protect his loved ones when an unexpected incident changes their lives.
note: A tightly constructed thriller that keeps its audience guessing.

title: RRR
synopsis: A fictional tale follows two legendary revolutionaries and their extraordinary friendship in colonial India.
note: A spectacular action epic built around loyalty and larger-than-life heroism.

title: Sita Ramam
synopsis: A letter from a woman sets off a journey to uncover the story of an army officer and a mysterious love.
note: A gentle romantic drama told through letters, memory and longing.

title: Kantara
synopsis: A conflict between a village and the forest department brings local traditions, land and belief into focus.
note: A rooted folk-action drama with striking atmosphere and intensity.

title: 777 Charlie
synopsis: A solitary factory worker finds a new sense of purpose after an energetic dog enters his life.
note: A warm road-trip story about companionship and personal change.
